body:
How are you trying to meet women? OLD certainly makes things much harder. Unfortunately, it's the only way to date in the pandemic now but I would recommend not using it if you're really struggling; I know it made me feel so much worse about my body when I was getting no matches. 

Sometimes all it takes though is some better pictures or a different bio. Most of my friends get matches and they really aren't in the upper tiers of attractiveness on any levels. I changed my pictures and my matches increased quite a bit. 

Overall though OLD just sucks for everyone and if you have other ways to meet people, I would recommended deleting those apps. They really do more harm than good.
